name: Resurrection Of Christ The
overview: The Resurrection of Christ stands as the divine affirmation of Jesus as the Son of God, fulfilling prophetic declarations such as those in Psalms 2:7 and Psalms 16:10, which speak of God's unique begotten Son who would not see corruption. This event, foreshadowed by the sign of Jonah's three days and nights in the heart of the earth (Matthew 12:40), confirms the hope of resurrection and eternal life, as Isaiah 26:19 declares the dead will rise. The resurrection is a cornerstone of Christian faith, validating Jesus' victory over death and securing the promise of judgment and forgiveness.
